reuse.why: Extends the existing getDateWithSkippedWeekend with a holidays parameter and a shared isWeekendOrHoliday predicate, but keeps that predicate private and re-writes it inline in two app.ts handlers.

duplication.why: The weekend-or-holiday check for daily skipping is written three times (isWeekendOrHoliday in shared, plus inline `d.isWeekend(date) || config.holidays?.includes(dayFromDate(date))` in getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange), and the skipWeekend ternary stays repeated at every site.

placement.why: The moving rule correctly lives in shared/schedules.ts, but the daily-skip holiday rule is spread into the server handlers instead of a shared helper.

scope.why: Focused on holidays, though it also adds daily weekend skipping to getUpcomingDates, which was a separate gap.

maintainability.why: Changing what counts as a non-working day requires editing the shared helper and two inline copies, which is easy to get out of step.

bypasses_abstraction.where: schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange re-implement the weekend-or-holiday predicate inline instead of using (an exported) isWeekendOrHoliday.

disguised_duplication.where: The inline predicates in app.ts getUpcomingDates (a negated filter) and getDatesInRange are reshaped copies of the private isWeekendOrHoliday in shared/schedules.ts.

one_place.where: Moving across holidays is defined once in getDateWithSkippedWeekend, but the daily-skip holiday rule is decided separately in shared getNextDate (isWeekendOrHoliday) and inline in app.ts getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange.
